title: Reactions and maximum moment of a simply supported beam
ticketBrief:
# Site query
A simply supported beam spans **5 m** and carries a uniformly distributed load of **12 kN/m** over the full span (self-weight already included).

The site engineer wants the support reaction and the maximum bending moment before approving the section.

steps.title: Support reaction
steps.instruction: Find the vertical reaction at each support.

steps.title: Maximum bending moment
steps.instruction: Find the maximum bending moment, which occurs at mid-span.

hints.body: For a symmetric load each support carries half of the total load. Total load = w × L.

title: Heat loss through a furnace wall
ticketBrief:
# Furnace audit
A flat furnace wall has area **12 m²**, thickness **0.25 m** and thermal conductivity **0.72 W/m·K**. The inner surface is at **450 °C** and the outer surface at **50 °C**. Assume steady, one-dimensional conduction.

Find the rate of heat loss through the wall.

steps.title: Heat loss
steps.instruction: Apply Fourier's law of conduction and report the result in kilowatts.

hints.body: ΔT is a temperature difference, so °C and K differences are equal.
